notes: Sound pop-out: one button opens every app's volume, the output and the microphone over the panel.
Power pop-out: lock, sleep, sign out, restart and shut down (hold to be sure). A small Power tile shows just its icon.
Buttons show only the icon when the name doesn't fit (or choose Always / Icon only).
Touching the panel no longer takes the game's focus: Control Hub gives it straight back (Look → Games).
